title: Semantic watermark audit: code and records for "What Does a Semantic Watermark Verify? An Audit of SEAL and a Tested Thumbnail Repair Candidate"
description: Evaluation code, saved numerical records and the paper PDF for an audit of SEAL (ICCV 2025), a semantic watermark for Stable Diffusion images, against CSI semantic forgeries. Recomputes every exported numeric or identifier macro used by the manuscript from saved records. Does not regenerate images or rerun models. The paper PDF is in paper/semantic-watermark-audit.pdf.
